---
title: "Chalte Chalte Mesum Abbas"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Gohar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Main Soye Karbala Ja Raha Tha Parhta Sallay Ala Chalte Chalte.
Pe Raha Tha Mawaddat Ke Sagar Aa Raha Tha Maza Chalte Chalte.
Shah-e-Karb-o-Bala Ki Ziyarat Karne Nikla Tha Main Apne Ghar Se.
Jo Qaza Ho Gayin Thin Namazein Ho Gayin Woh Ada Chalte Chalte.

2
Kuch Qadam Hur Barha Sheh Ki Janib Kuch Qadam Sheh Barhey Hur Ki Janib.
Bakhsh Di Chand Lamhon Mein Sheh Ne Hur Ki Sari Khata Chalte Chalte.
Bugz-e-Haider Tha Seene Mein Jis Ke Woh Tawaf-e-Haram Kar Raha Tha.
Aayi Taqdeer Chakar Mein Aisi Seedha Dozakh Gaya Chalte Chalte.

3
Shah-e-Konain Zainab Ke Bhai Tum Ne Tauheed Aisay Bachai.
Dhondne Nikla Jo Bhi Khuda Ko Aa Gaya Karbala Chalte Chalte.
Aye Yazid Ab Tujhey Qaid Karne Tauq-o-Zanjeer Beri Uthaye.
Dekh Shair-e-Elahi Ka Beta Sham Tak Aa Gaya Chalte Chalte.

4
Ho Rahi Thi Dhamak Iss Bala Ki Ruk Gayin Sansein Ahl-e-Jafa Ki.
Kar Ke Dhak Dhak Wilayi Ke Dil Ne Aisa Matam Kiya Chalte Chalte.
Fakhar Se Bolay Gohar Se Meesum Har Ghari Har Nafas Dam Hama Dam.
Jhoom Uthay Gi Sari Khudai Woh Karein Gay Sana Chalte Chalte.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script, preserving their order across four stanzas. Moved the Roman transcription to `romanLyrics` with only casing and verse-end punctuation changes. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman title, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read “sagar” as ساغر in the drinking verse and “Shair-e-Elahi” as شیرِ الٰہی.
